description: This file defines a Dart class `NewsApiClient` for fetching top news headlines from the NewsAPI service, including error handling via `NewsApiException`. It handles HTTP requests, JSON decoding, and transforms API responses into a list of `NewsArticle` objects. It also manages environment variables for API keys.

classes.name: NewsApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class for API-related errors.

classes.name: NewsApiClient
classes.description: Client class for fetching news headlines from the NewsAPI service, with error handling and JSON parsing.

methods.name: fetchTopHeadlines
methods.description: Fetches top news headlines for a specified country and optional category from the NewsAPI.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the internal HttpClient, releasing resources.
